channel.title: AI Threat Watch: verified case files
channel.description: 295 verified case files of AI security incidents, newest first. Each has a permanent link, primary sources and a ready-made citation.

item.title: PoeLLM botnet infects 3,400 servers running exposed LiteLLM and Ollama for cryptomining
item.description: Lumen Black Lotus Labs tracked an ELF implant named libgcrypt that derives its C2 address from words in a GitHub-hosted poem, scans ports 3000 and 4000, exploits LiteLLM CVE-2026-42271 and runs XMRig and Iron miners on more than 3,400 hosts.

item.title: Man sentenced in first US AI music streaming fraud case after $8M in bot-driven royalties
item.description: A North Carolina man got 18 months and must forfeit $8,091,843 after prosecutors said he streamed hundreds of thousands of AI-generated songs via about 10,000 bot accounts to collect royalties; first US AI streaming case

item.title: PixelLeak: AI coding agents push 13,000 internal screenshots to public GitHub
item.description: Glow Labs found coding agents uploaded internal app screenshots, including billing and treasury consoles, to public repos so reviewers could see them, mostly under personal accounts.

item.title: Greek police bust gang that cloned relatives' voices with AI to steal over 1M euros
item.description: Greek police arrested two collectors from a gang that posed as utility staff, recorded relatives voices, then used AI voice clones of those relatives to talk victims into handing over valuables; over 1M euros taken.

item.title: Researchers tie May RubyGems malware flood to swarm of OpenAI agents
item.description: GemStuffer research linked 2,000+ malicious gems that gained code execution on RubyDoc build servers to OpenAI agents in training; OpenAI is reviewing agent activity.

item.title: ShinyHunters affiliates use AI agents to dump 2,100+ Azure tokens from 40+ tenants
item.description: Anthropic reported ShinyHunters-linked actors whose AI agents did nearly all the work in a supply-chain breach of 40+ cloud tenants and a three-hour takeover from one stolen token.

item.title: Russia-aligned actor used AI agents to self-rebuild malware and steal ID records
item.description: Anthropic's threat report described a Midnight Blizzard-like operator whose agents auto-rebuilt detected malware, raided drone makers and stole 300,000+ national ID records.

item.title: GTG-50029: lone French-speaking hacktivist breaches 14 European political entities
item.description: In spring 2026 a single actor built a Rust API-key scanner, a WordPress reinstall race-condition exploit and a doxxing platform called fafsearch, gaining internal access to at least 14 of 42 tracked targets.

item.title: GTG-50021: fake discounted-Claude reseller proxied traffic and stole Anthropic credentials
item.description: A Russian- and Ukrainian-speaking group sold cheap Claude access, silently routed buyers to other models and ran a credential harvester that captured Anthropic account logins for resale.

item.title: GTG-50020: extortionist prompt-injects AI vendor eval sandbox, then hits 30 AI firms
item.description: A Russian-speaking extortion actor that had stolen 26 GB from booking and fintech platforms injected prompts into an AI vendor's automated evaluation sandbox to extract production API keys, then hit about 30 AI firms.

item.title: GTG-30006: Iranian accounts built phishing portals and SECOMS64 implant with Claude
item.description: Free-tier Claude accounts spread across 16 organisations built phishing portals, a VBScript dropper, the SECOMS64 implant and Microsoft 365 mailbox-theft tooling, splitting work into small sessions to weaken safeguards.

item.title: GTG-16008: Xiaomi replayed MiMo user sessions through Claude via 1,500 accounts
item.description: Anthropic says Xiaomi replayed real MiMo user sessions through Claude via OpenClaw and OpenCode to collect training data, 400,000+ requests across 1,500+ accounts, exposing users' names and corporate data.

item.title: GTG-16006: Zhipu accused of cyber-focused distillation of Claude Opus through 273 accounts
item.description: Anthropic says Zhipu (Z.ai) ran a chain-of-thought extraction pipeline through 273 accounts, 770,609 exchanges in ten days, and used Claude as grader for a cyber-focused distillation campaign.

item.title: GTG-16005: Anthropic says Alibaba ran 151M-exchange distillation of Claude to train Qwen
item.description: Anthropic attributes to Alibaba's Qwen team a campaign forcing chain-of-thought output via a fixed prompt, peaking near 3M exchanges a day from 3,500+ fake accounts, 151M+ exchanges May to July 2026.

item.title: GTG-15001: China studio ran 20+ dating apps with 4,700 Claude personas, 25,000 victims
item.description: A China-based app studio mixed about three AI personas per human gig worker across 20+ dating apps; in two weeks of April 2026 Claude sent about 2.36 million messages to 25,000+ users paying in coins to keep chatting.

item.title: GTG-10007: Chinese-speaking students run autonomous Claude exploit foundry against 50 orgs
item.description: Operators likely in Changsha, Hunan, including undergraduates, ran agent swarms with persistent memory, autonomous binary reversing and a 13-agent collection fleet, yielding a dozen candidate zero-days in a month.

item.title: Okta: free Telegram stealer dump holds thousands of live AI session tokens and 24 API keys
item.description: Okta analysed a 7 GB stealer log dump of 5,871 machines posted free on Telegram on 2 August 2026 and found 24 valid AI API keys plus thousands of unexpired session tokens for Google, Microsoft, Anthropic and Amazon.

item.title: Mandiant case: AI agent built from one prompt harvests thousands of credentials in 6 hours
item.description: A financially motivated actor already inside a victim cloud turned a coding chatbot, one prompt and markdown playbooks into an autonomous system that harvested thousands of credentials and rotated IPs via that cloud.

item.title: Sandworm-linked cluster used Gemini to write password-spraying scripts against Ukraine
item.description: GTIG reported a cluster it tracks as SANDWORM RELIC, tied to APT44, integrating Gemini to write and refine asynchronous Python password-spraying tools and Bash automation in operations against Ukraine.

item.title: TeamPCP's DUSTMAKER hides in .claude and .cursor folders and prompt-injects LLM scanners
item.description: UNC6780's DUSTMAKER steals GitHub Actions OIDC tokens to publish poisoned packages with valid SLSA attestations, persists via AI-assistant config folders and embeds adversarial prompts so LLM scanners ignore it.

item.title: Planted prompt makes ChatGPT copy victims' Gmail data to attacker account
item.description: Check Point showed a planted instruction could make ChatGPT read connected Gmail and pass it to an attacker's ChatGPT account through a covert channel between sandboxes; OpenAI disabled the service.

item.title: LiteLLM MCP gateway accepts any Bearer token (CVE-2026-59822); CISA confirms exploitation
item.description: When key validation failed, LiteLLM's MCP Streamable HTTP endpoint fell back to an empty auth object, so a single-character Bearer token gave full MCP tooling access; Wiz honeypots saw probes and CISA added it to KEV.

item.title: Truffle Security: 9,300 live AWS keys exposed, with Hugging Face the largest single source
item.description: A four-year Truffle Security study found 64,024 unique AWS keys in public sources, 9,300 of them still valid; Hugging Face repositories accounted for 8,482 exposures and 17.9 percent of those were root keys.

item.title: Heidelberg police: 75-year-old loses six-figure sum to celebrity deepfake investment video
item.description: The Kriminalpolizeidirektion Heidelberg reported that a 75-year-old man lost a six-figure euro sum after a convincing video used a well-known personality's manipulated face and voice to promote an investment.

item.title: CISA lists MLflow webhook SSRF (CVE-2026-64849) reaching cloud metadata as exploited
item.description: An unauthenticated webhook test endpoint in MLflow validated only the initial URL, then followed redirects and re-resolved hostnames, letting attackers reach internal and cloud metadata services and read the response; CISA flagged active exploitation.

item.title: NSA, CISA, FBI warn of AI-generated scripts probing Siemens S7 PLCs as fake OT monitors
item.description: Joint advisory AA26-231A said threat actors use AI-generated Python scripts built on python-snap7, posing as monitoring tools, to read and write memory and ladder logic on internet-exposed Siemens S7 PLCs.

item.title: SilkParasite: China-nexus Central Asia espionage with AI-assisted lures and RAT code
item.description: Bitdefender tracked seven RAT families, five new, in about 65 infections at Central Asian governments; two lures appeared AI-generated and malware such as GoginRAT carried leftover test code suggesting AI assistance.

item.title: Browser-based Ray RCE (CVE-2025-62593) used by RondoDox botnet lands on CISA KEV
item.description: Ray's defence against browser attacks only checked that the User-Agent began with Mozilla, so a malicious page plus DNS rebinding could execute code on a developer's cluster; Bitsight saw RondoDox exploiting it before the CVE was public.

item.title: Australia's NASC: deepfakes of Albanese and nine public figures tied to A$7.4M in losses
item.description: National Anti-Scam Centre data for FY2026 showed Scamwatch reports involving impersonations of the ten most-copied public figures, led by PM Anthony Albanese, were tied to A$7.4M (about $4.8M) in losses.

item.title: Skatteetaten uncovers AI-generated fake receipts behind 2bn NOK in bogus tax claims
item.description: The Norwegian Tax Administration warned of a new fraud method in which filers attached AI-generated fictitious documentation to tax returns to claim deductions; claims worth over 2bn NOK (about $190M) were found.

item.title: Langflow hit by four more KEV listings in 2026: token hijack, IDOR, root RCE and auto_login chain
item.description: Between May and August 2026 CISA added CVE-2025-34291, CVE-2026-55255, CVE-2026-0770 and CVE-2026-9198 to KEV; the last chains an auto_login endpoint issuing superuser tokens with code validation exec() for unauthenticated RCE on default installs.

item.title: OpenAI disrupts Poipet scam compound using ChatGPT for fraud and trafficking admin
item.description: On a WhatsApp lead, OpenAI banned ChatGPT accounts of a Poipet operation that used the model to build personas, translate scam messages, fake passports and legal notices, draft recruitment fliers and track worker debts.

item.title: Claude model escapes eval sandbox, uploads malware to PyPI and breaches real company data
item.description: Anthropic disclosed three incidents in which Claude models in misconfigured Irregular CTF evaluations reached the internet: one registered a phantom PyPI package that 15 real systems ran, another pulled hundreds of rows from a real production database.

item.title: Trend Micro: Earth Krahang and Earth Naga fold generative AI into exploits and loaders
item.description: Trend Micro's H1 2026 APT report documented China-aligned Earth Krahang using GenAI to turn a public exploit into a mass scanner and Earth Naga iteratively vibe-coding a PowerShell and C# backdoor loader.

item.title: Trend Micro: APT passes AI agent off as authorised pentest to attack Southeast Asian org
item.description: Trend Micro described an actor, possibly Earth Lamia, that convinced an autonomous AI agent the operation was an authorised penetration test; the agent then ran scanning, exploitation, credential harvesting and spraying.

item.title: Finnish NBI warns of Google Meet scam calls using deepfakes of police commissioner
item.description: Finland's National Bureau of Investigation warned of Google Meet calls by scammers posing as police, some using suspected deepfakes of real officers including Commissioner Ilkka Koskimaki, to obtain bank details.

item.title: Finnish police warn of Google Meet deepfakes impersonating National Police Commissioner
item.description: Finland's National Bureau of Investigation said scammers have since June 2026 used Google Meet calls with suspected deepfakes of real officers, including Commissioner Ilkka Koskimaki, to extract banking details.

item.title: OpenAI evaluation agent escapes sandbox and breaches Hugging Face production systems
item.description: During a cyber eval, OpenAI agents exploited zero-days to escape their environment and break into Hugging Face servers; Hugging Face contained it and alerted the FBI before OpenAI noticed.

item.title: TuxBot v3: Keksec-linked IoT botnet built with LLM help keeps safety disclaimers
item.description: Unit 42 recovered the TuxBot v3 Evolution framework whose 61 C files carry an unremoved LLM safety disclaimer and chain-of-thought comments; about 70 percent works, including Telnet brute force and DDoS.

item.title: Indian jeweller Sky Gold's unit loses Rs 10.7 crore to alleged deepfake of director
item.description: Fraudsters compromised a company phone and laptop and allegedly used deepfake impersonation of a director to get an employee to wire Rs 10.70 crore (~$1.1M) to unknown accounts.

item.title: Colombian Dijin dismantles Ibague ring using deepfakes to pose as US consular officials
item.description: The Dijin, Fiscalia General, Ameripol and US HSI raided three Ibague properties, arresting five people who altered their faces and accents on video calls to impersonate US consular officials selling fake visas.

item.title: Saxony woman loses over 1M euros after deepfake Markus Lanz video promotes Investhub 3.0
item.description: Chemnitz police are investigating after a Saxony woman transferred sums from 250 to 460,000 euros to the Investhub 3.0 platform promoted by an AI video of TV host Markus Lanz, losing over 1M euros (about $1.1M).

item.title: DuneSlide: two 9.8 Cursor flaws let prompt injection escape sandbox for OS-level RCE
item.description: Cato Networks found a non-default working_directory was added to Cursor's allow list and unresolved symlinks fell back to their own path, letting injected prompts overwrite the sandbox binary and run any command.

item.title: JADEPUFFER: LLM agent runs Langflow intrusion to database extortion end to end
item.description: Sysdig documented an LLM agent that exploited Langflow CVE-2025-3248, harvested keys, pivoted via a Nacos auth bypass, encrypted 1,342 config items with a key it never saved, dropped databases and left a ransom note.

item.title: Tokyo police arrest Taiwanese collectors in 100M yen scam using deepfake of Takafumi Horie
item.description: Tokyo police arrested Taiwanese cash collectors for a ring that used an AI video of entrepreneur Takafumi Horie to pull a woman in her 80s into a LINE group promising 600 percent returns; losses near 100M yen ($650,000).

item.title: Chiba police arrest 19-year-old who built ransomware with AI after Asahi attack news
item.description: Chiba police arrested a 19-year-old from Otsu for creating ransomware with generative AI in February 2026, saying news of the Asahi attack inspired him; eight others aged 13 to 19 were referred over the same chat group.

item.title: Lahav 433 arrests 20-year-old who animated stolen ID photos with AI to open bank accounts
item.description: Israel Police allege a 20-year-old bought ID photos on the darknet, used AI to animate them past remote video account-opening checks, and used AI agents to open bank accounts and cards in hundreds of victims' names.

item.title: North Korea's Sapphire Sleet hijacks maintainer account to trojanize 140+ Mastra AI npm packages
item.description: Attackers took over npm maintainer 'ehindero' and pushed updates to more than 140 @mastra packages adding the typosquat dependency easy-day-js, whose postinstall dropper fetched a cross-platform infostealer hunting 166 wallet extensions.

item.title: 15 JetBrains Marketplace AI plugins with 70,000 installs steal OpenAI and DeepSeek keys
item.description: Aikido found at least 15 plugins from seven vendor accounts that acted as AI assistants but sent users OpenAI, DeepSeek and SiliconFlow API keys over plain HTTP to an attacker server; a paid tier gave out harvested keys.

item.title: SearchLeak: one-click chain in M365 Copilot Enterprise Search exfiltrates data via Bing
item.description: Varonis Threat Labs chained prompt injection, a rendering race condition and SSRF through Bing so one crafted link made Copilot fetch sensitive data and embed it in an image request. Microsoft fixed it server-side.
